title: Mathematical Analysis: A Modern Approach to Advanced Calculus
verification_note: Second edition; stable ISBN identity. Used for sequences and limits, continuity, one-variable differentiation, Riemann integration, infinite series, power series, and multivariable calculus foundations.

version_history.change: Initial C05 source record for academic Block A.

title: Measure, Integration & Real Analysis
verification_note: First edition 2020 with persistent Springer DOI. Used for measure, measurable functions, Lebesgue integration and convergence theorems, Lp spaces, Banach/Hilbert spaces and bounded linear functionals/operators.

version_history.change: Added for academic Block B real/functional analysis.

title: Complex Analysis
verification_note: AMS reprint of the third edition, stable ISBN identity. Used for holomorphic functions, Cauchy theory, analytic continuation basics, Laurent series, isolated singularities, residues and harmonic-function relations.

version_history.change: Added for academic Block B complex analysis.

title: Fourier Analysis: An Introduction
verification_note: First edition 2003, stable ISBN identity. Used for Fourier series, orthogonality, Fourier transform, convolution, Riemann-Lebesgue and Plancherel/Parseval foundations.

version_history.change: Added for academic Block B harmonic analysis.
